rooms.name: The Rabbit Hole
rooms.description: The bottom of a very deep well. Cupboards and bookshelves line the walls, with maps and pictures hung on pegs, and a jar labelled ORANGE MARMALADE on one shelf. The light comes from somewhere high above. A low passage leads east.

rooms.name: The Hall of Doors
rooms.description: A long, low hall lit by a row of lamps hanging from the roof. There are doors all round it, every one of them locked. In the middle stands a little three-legged table made of solid glass. A tiny door behind a curtain opens east, towards the garden. The passage back to the well is west.

rooms.name: The Garden
rooms.description: Beds of bright flowers and cool fountains. A large rose-tree stands near the entrance; the roses on it are white, but three gardeners are busily painting them red. A path leads north between the trees, towards the sound of cups and saucers. The little door back to the hall is west.

rooms.name: The Tea Party
rooms.description: A table set out under a tree in front of a house, laid for a great many more than the three who sit at it. The March Hare and the Hatter are having tea, with a Dormouse fast asleep between them. It is always six o'clock here. The garden path is south.

characters.name: Hatter
characters.persona: The Hatter from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, at the endless tea party. Riddles, puns about Time, cheerful rudeness. See generator prompt for the full soul.
